name: Text 7
text:
Extra Trees leads on every metric: RMSE 15.68 ₹ Cr, R² 0.52.
The OLS baseline is second-best (R² 0.41), suggesting much of the climate effect is near-linear.
Boosted models trail on this small panel of 150 observations.
R² of about 0.52 means roughly half the variance is explained, so outputs are estimates, not forecasts.
Random split points likely help with collinear rainfall and temperature anomalies.

name: Text 6
text:
Built an end-to-end system: data ingestion, panel preparation, five ML models, scenario simulation and a web platform.
Benchmarked models on a strict chronological split (train 2009–2019, test 2020–2023) to avoid temporal leakage.
Extra Trees performed best: RMSE 15.68 ₹ Cr, MAE 12.19 ₹ Cr, R² 0.5224 on unseen years.
The Scenario Lab turns model output into what-if estimates that support proactive agricultural policy.
